message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Step | Description | |---|------|-------------| | 1 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | 2 | **Turn Order** | • Players take turns clockwise (or counterclockwise if a Reverse card is played). | | 3 | **Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | 4 | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and misses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color to play.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and misses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can challenge.) | | 5 | **Winning a Round** | • The first player to discard all of their cards wins the round.
• Score points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands:
  – Number cards: face value
  – Draw Two / Reverse / Skip: 20 points
  – Wild / Wild Draw Four: 50 points | | 6 | **Winning the Game** | • Play continues until a player reaches a predetermined score (commonly 500 points). That player is the overall winner. | --- ### Optional Variations | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | If a player has a matching Draw Two or Wild Draw Four, they can stack it on the previous one, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they also stack. | | **Seven-O** | When a player plays a 7, they can swap hands with another player. When a player plays an 0, everyone passes their hand in the same direction as play. | | **Jump-In** | If a player has an exact duplicate of the top card, they can play it immediately, even out of turn. | | **Custom Rules** | Many groups add house rules (e.g., “Draw One” instead of “Draw Two,” “No Wild Draw Four” rule, etc.). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on colors** – Try to keep a variety of colors in your hand so you’re not stuck when the color changes. 2. **Use action cards strategically** – Save Draw Twos or Wilds for when you’re close to winning or when you want to block a strong opponent. 3. **Watch opponents’ hands** – If someone is down to one card, try to play a Skip or Draw Two on them to prevent an easy win. 4. **Challenge Wild Draw Four** – If you suspect the previous player had a playable card, you can challenge. If they were right, they draw six cards; if wrong, you draw eight. Enjoy playing Uno!
